attributes.text: PRODUCT ENHANCEMENT
Your Green Street MCP Server Subscription Just Got Better
YOU HAVE ACCESS TO NEW ENHANCEMENTS
Green Street News is Now Inside the MCP Server

News is now live in your MCP Server at no extra cost. Ask a natural-language question about Green Street News and get a sourced answer back. There's nothing to set up; it's ready to use right now. Ask about CRE headlines the same way you already ask about Research and Market Data. Ask Your First Question →
New Workflow Tools for Smarter AI Queries

A new set of workflow tools are now available to you within the MCP Server. These workflow tools go beyond single question retrieval, giving you summarized, dashboard style views of Green Street content directly inside your AI Assistant. See an overview of the tools available to you, below. Start Exploring On Your Own →
Workflow Tools Overview:
Green Street Concierge
New to the MCP server? This tool orients you to what's available, surfaces personalized prompts based on your role, and answers metric and methodology questions on demand.
Try: "Help me get started with Green Street MCP server" →
Green Street Digest
Get a personalized daily or weekly summary of Green Street research, earnings Quick Takes, sales comps, and key metrics scoped to your coverage area.
Try: "Run my digest: daily, SoCal apartments and strip retail" →
NEED SUPPORT?

Our Customer Success team is here to help ensure you are getting full value from the Green Street MCP Server. Connect with us to get a personalized walkthrough or to learn more about the tools available to you.
Connect With Support →
